title: AERO9500 Preliminary Report (Part 1)
overview: Design a new space mission benefiting Australia and identify main elements of its space segment. Demonstrate understanding of space segment systems (launch, orbits etc.) by developing a preliminary plan for the mission. Part 1 is a planning report to guide Part 2 main assignment.
deliverables: Preliminary report (single PDF) presenting mission plan and preliminary technical work

format.structure: Mission concept and rationale (what it does, users, need); Project plan including Gantt chart or timetable and sources of information; Preliminary progress with technical content
format.other: Use software of choice (STK, PIGI, flightclub/other with approval) supplemented with hand calculations as needed

requirements.text: Mission must benefit Australia; keep concept simple - suggested ideas: bushfire tracking and alert system, weather satellite, internet/communication, earth observation for city planning/real estate.
Present mission concept and its rationale including what it will do, who are the users, why it is needed.
Present project plan for how to complete the full assignment, including either a Gantt chart or a timetable.
List sources of information planned to use for design.

Decide and state which software package will be used to complete the design: STK, PIGI (requires registration for license via competition), or other software (e.g., flightclub) after discussion with instructor.
Provide preliminary progress with technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date showing understanding of space segment systems (launch, orbits etc.).
Supplement software design with hand calculations as needed.
